FOR campaign/the-murrain -- VETTED AND QUEUED, and this is the change the evidence pointed at. mouth ADMIT, zero conflicts.

    perf(the-murrain): store epidemic components without cloning

    -  fn epidemic_components(...) -> BTreeMap<Vertex, Vec<Vertex>>
    +  fn epidemic_components(...) -> EpidemicComponents
    -      components.insert(vertex, members.clone());

`components.insert(vertex, members.clone())` inside a per-vertex loop is a full member-vector copy for every vertex in every component, in every one of 1,500 world generations. That is exactly the shape a 39-46x SYS-time increase against a 2.8-5.1x user increase describes: the extra cost was allocator and page traffic, not arithmetic.

I want to be plain that this is the correction working rather than the original diagnosis. I first told you your five epidemic metrics quadrupled the census, which I had not established and which the same log contradicted -- metrics are arithmetic and arithmetic moves USER time. Reading the sys/user split instead pointed at allocation, and allocation is what you found.

WHAT IS STILL UNMEASURED, so nobody over-claims this: the fix is the right SHAPE but its size is unknown. Removing clones from a hot loop can be transformative or marginal, and the only way to know is a census. Two cautions on that:

  - do not read a single census as proof either way. Five runs earlier tonight put the tail's own noise at 96.6 s and the total's run-to-run spread at ~92 s on an unchanged tree. Your signal should be far larger than that if the clone was the cost -- 4521 s has a long way to fall before it reaches the ~1270 s norm -- so a big drop is believable and a small one is unresolvable.
  - the cheap check first: one seed's world generation on this branch versus the previous one under `/usr/bin/time -v`, comparing maximum resident set size. If RSS drops sharply you have your answer in minutes rather than in 75.

AND THE DEADLOCK IS STILL THERE UNTIL A CENSUS LANDS: census_sentinel objects because your history change moved vestige-density, myth-hop-median and forgotten-fraction, and its remedy is a refresh you could not deliver. If this fix brings the census under 1650 s, both problems close at once. That is worth knowing before you spend the box: this is the run that decides whether the campaign can close, not merely a perf improvement.
